note: Swap this file each week. The scores page shows it only when week matches meta.currentWeek in league-all-teams.json. Team names, abbreviations, and records are taken from that directory, not from the words in headline or roast.

matchups.headline: Kabul FC Cashed In on Thursday. Easy Peasy Lemon Squeezy Still Has Josh Allen.
matchups.roast: Kabul FC banked 46.42 before Sunday because Chuba Hubbard (24.9) and Jordan Love (21.52) both started in the same game, and Kabul FC is 9th in points for (776.74), so it needed every one of them. The bad news is that Jaylen Waddle and Jakobi Meyers both start as Questionable. Easy Peasy Lemon Squeezy has Tee Higgins, Courtland Sutton and Stefon Diggs on the bench while Parker Washington starts. It also starts a Jaguars D/ST that averaged -2.0 over Weeks 4-7. Easy Peasy Lemon Squeezy leads the all-time series 9-5, so Kabul FC's Thursday head start may not hold.
matchups.tag: UPSET ALERT: Kabul FC leads 46.42-0, but ESPN still projects Easy Peasy Lemon Squeezy to win by 11.4.

matchups.headline: Sandusky's Soldiers Benched 17.3 Points and Still Leads
matchups.roast: Sandusky's Soldiers left Tucker Kraft on the bench for his 17.3-point Thursday and started Jalen Coker (9.6) instead. Sandusky's Soldiers has lost three straight, including a season-low 92.98 last week. Smert Fellas is starting DeVonta Smith, who is listed Out, and so far its only points are 5 from the Panthers D/ST. Smert Fellas is 2-5, and 98.5 is the lowest projection in the league this week.
matchups.tag: LOCK: Sandusky's Soldiers, projected to win by 27.0. Smert Fellas is starting a player listed Out.

matchups.headline: All Heart's Ex, Josh Jacobs, Scored 23.2 for Someone Else on Thursday
matchups.roast: All Heart traded Josh Jacobs, Cam Skattebo and DJ Moore to Maye Day on Oct 15. Jacobs scored 23.2 for his new team on Thursday, while DK Metcalf and Chase Brown have yet to play for All Heart. All Heart also has Christian McCaffrey, Patrick Mahomes, Travis Kelce and Chris Olave on the bench, so the bench might outscore the starters. Jahmyr I Go Again has lost two straight with 75.88 and 97.2 after opening 3-0. It still starts Jahmyr Gibbs, Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams, so it has no excuse. The all-time series is tied 7-7.
matchups.tag: UPSET ALERT: All Heart's Christian Watson already has 17.3, and JAH is favored by only 14.6.

matchups.headline: The League's Top Scorer vs. the League's Best Record
matchups.roast: Chewy's Warriors lead the league with 992.74 points for and still sit at 4-3. De'Von Achane is on IR, while Emeka Egbuka and Kyle Monangai are listed Out. Chewy's Warriors is also starting Dallas Goedert over Sam LaPorta. Bibi's Boys is 6-1 on five straight wins despite ranking just 4th in points for. It has scored between 117.06 and 135.72 every week, so it never surprises anyone, and it keeps winning. Bibi's Boys leads the all-time series 9-8.
matchups.tag: LOCK: Bibi's Boys, projected to win by 14.8.

matchups.headline: The Last-Place Points Team vs. the Team That Keeps Winning Without Points
matchups.roast: Maye Day is 2-5 and last in points for with 771.16. Its best moves came by trade: Josh Jacobs (23.2) and waiver pickup Matthew Golden (20.9) already have 44.1 points. Maye Day is still starting Harold Fannin Jr. at TE because Isaiah Likely is on bye, and DJ Moore starts as Questionable, so even this good week has holes. Dimes McSorley has won four straight while ranking just 8th in points for. On Thursday its QB, Bryce Young, scored 10.36 after being sacked six times. Dimes McSorley is starting Brenton Strange at TE with George Kittle on the bench. Dimes McSorley leads the all-time series 5-3, but Maye Day won the last meeting 127.84-74.48 in 2025.
matchups.tag: LOCK: Maye Day, the week's top projection at 142.7, favored by 26.8.
